blocks.text:
After breakfast at your hotel, set off on a private four-hour city tour with an English-speaking guide. Buenos Aires has a European charm: its grand buildings and wide avenues recall Paris or Barcelona, yet the Argentine capital has a distinctive Latin American character. See the famous Casa Rosada (Pink House), the magnificent Teatro Colón and the iconic Obelisk on Avenida 9 de Julio, then visit La Boca, one of the birthplaces of tango. Stroll along colourful Caminito, with its vivid façades and the aroma of grilled meat. Continue to sophisticated Recoleta, known for its stylish bars and restaurants, and Plaza San Martín, framed by neoclassical architecture.

Buenos Aires is celebrated as tango’s birthplace, and there is no better place to experience this passionate dance. In the evening, enjoy a first-class dinner and tango show, with Argentine beef grilled over charcoal, homemade pasta, delicious desserts, international and local specialities and a selection of Argentine wines — an ideal finale to your time in the city.
